items.abstract:
<jats:p>We consider ideals in a polynomial ring generated by collections of power sum
polynomials, and obtain conditions under which these define complete intersection
rings, normal domains, and unique factorization domains. We also settle
a key case of a conjecture of Conca, Krattenthaler, and Watanabe, and prove
other results in that direction.</jats:p>
title: IDEALS GENERATED BY POWER SUMS
